_comment: Portable OpenHands Agent Canvas LLM wiring — tracked in dot-files, merged
WHY A MERGE, NOT A FULL RENDER: settings.json is app-owned and carries 56
llm keys plus agent/conversation schema the app bumps on its own. We patch
only the routing keys below and preserve everything else, so an app upgrade
that adds fields does not get reverted.
WRITE IT WHILE THE APP IS CLOSED. Agent Canvas holds .settings.lock and
rewrites settings.json on exit; syncing against a running app loses the edit.
PORT CONTRACT: Agent Canvas HARDCODES localhost:8000 / 18000 / 18001 in its
Electron main.mjs (loadURL, waitForUrl, waitForAgentServer) and cannot be
reconfigured in the desktop build. vLLM was moved off :8000 to :8010 on
2026-08-30 to make room — see VLLM_PORT in projects/enclave-vllm/serve*.sh.
GPU REALITY: only ONE model fits the 24 GB card. While enclave-vllm holds it
(~22.3 GB at utilization 0.96) Ollama has ~1.4 GB and cannot load onto the
GPU, so the ollama profiles crawl on CPU. Flip backends with
projects/enclave-vllm/switch-model.sh, not by editing this file.
SELECT A PROFILE:  CLAW_CANVAS_PROFILE=direct-vllm claw ai config sync

litellm-vllm._note: PRIMARY. Gateway :4000 -> enclave-vllm-38u :8010. qwen3.8-27b-abliterated, 77824 ctx, ~27 tok/s.

litellm-ollama-coder._note: Gateway :4000 -> ollama qwen3-coder:30b. CPU-bound while vLLM holds the card.

direct-vllm._note: TROUBLESHOOTING. Bypasses LiteLLM entirely. If this works and litellm-vllm does not, the gateway is at fault, not the model.

direct-ollama._note: TROUBLESHOOTING. Bypasses LiteLLM. Only usable once vLLM is stopped and the card is free.

common._note: Applied to every profile. max_output_tokens is deliberately large: this checkpoint reasons before answering and a short budget returns an EMPTY message — measured 2026-08-25, see serve38u.sh.
